abi.signature: void readCurve(Json* frame, void* curveTimeline, int frameIndex)
abi.r0: per-frame Json object (the frame map that also carries 'time'/'angle'/...); every call site reloads frame->next right after the call
abi.r1: curve timeline pointer, the same pointer passed to <Type>Timeline_setFrame
abi.r2: 0-based frame index, whole 32-bit word, passed through unmodified
abi.return: void — none of the 8 callers reads r0

functions.semantics: Json_getItem(frame,"curve") → NULL ⇒ return; type(Json+0x08)==4 (string) ⇒ strcmp(string_value@+0x10,"stepped")==0 ⇒ tail-call spCurveTimeline_setStepped(timeline,frameIndex); type==5 (array) ⇒ read four ->next nodes' float_value@+0x18 in order cx1,cy1,cx2,cy2 and call spCurveTimeline_setCurve(timeline,frameIndex,cx1,cy1,cx2,cy2); any other type ⇒ no-op

curve_data_shape.answer: 'curve' is EITHER the JSON string "stepped" OR a JSON array of four numbers; there is no other accepted form
curve_data_shape.array_length: the declared element count at Json+0x0c is NEVER read (0x28b3b8 jumps straight to child, 0x28b3c4/0x28b3d0/0x28b3dc follow ->next). A short chain therefore reads the following sibling nodes (NULL tail ⇒ fault); elements past the fourth are ignored
curve_data_shape.element_type: no per-element type check — the raw 32-bit value at +0x18 is forwarded as a float
curve_data_shape.argument_contract: element 0..3 → cx1,cy1,cx2,cy2 of spCurveTimeline_setCurve(self, frameIndex, cx1, cy1, cx2, cy2) (6 AAPCS words: r0,r1,r2,r3,[sp],[sp,#4])
curve_data_shape.string_match: case-SENSITIVE strcmp at 0x28b398 (unlike Json_getItem's strcasecmp key lookup); "STEPPED"/"catmullrom"/"" are silently ignored

quirks: absent 'curve' (0x28b36c beq 0x28b384): plain return, no timeline write, no allocation
non-string/non-array type: falls into the same epilogue, no write
the string branch pops {r4,r5,lr} and branches (0x28b3b4 b 0x2817c0), i.e. a tail call; the array branch returns through its own pop at 0x28b3f0
no NULL guard on curve->child before the +0x18 load at 0x28b3c8 — a zero-element curve array faults (proven by fixture/check.c -DCURVE_NULL_PROBE: qemu exit -11)
